image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a dark, textured rocky surface. The subject displays an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal armor consisting of eight overlapping, pale greenish-white calcareous plates. These plates are surrounded by a brownish, granular leathery girdle (mantle). The lighting highlights the texture of the plates and the roughness of the surrounding rock.
